pageDescription: At Hotel Shuktara Dhaka, we offer a wide range of comfortable accommodations to ensure a delightful stay. Our 99 meticulously designed guest rooms span 7 categories — from Standard Single rooms to Premium Deluxe Kings — each equipped with modern amenities for the utmost comfort and convenience. Guests can enjoy complimentary breakfast at our Skylight Rooftop Restaurant, served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM, along with airport transfer services, making every aspect of your stay seamless and relaxing.

rooms.name: PREMIUM TRIPLE
rooms.description: Our Premium Triple Rooms are spacious and ideal for families or groups seeking extra comfort. Each room features three comfortable beds, private bathroom, high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning, flat-screen TV, and room service.
rooms.fullDescription: Our Premium Triple Rooms are spacious and ideal for families seeking a relaxing stay. Each room features three comfortable beds, a private bathroom, a refrigerator, and a range of modern amenities. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, a minibar, 24/7 room service, and ample storage with a wardrobe. Additionally, the room is air-conditioned and includes a large flat-screen TV with a variety of international channels, ensuring comfort and convenience for all guests.

rooms.name: DELUXE TWIN
rooms.description: Our Deluxe Twin rooms offer a stylish and relaxing environment, beautifully decorated in soothing warm tones. These rooms come with two comfortable single beds, dynamic workspace, and fully equipped modern amenities.
rooms.fullDescription: Our Deluxe Twin Rooms offer a cozy and relaxing environment, beautifully decorated in soothing white hues. These rooms come with air conditioning, a private bathroom, a refrigerator, and a flat-screen TV with a variety of international channels. Enjoy the convenience of complimentary Wi-Fi, a minibar, 24/7 room service, and ample storage with a wardrobe. The rooms are also equipped with comfortable twin beds, making them an ideal choice for a relaxing stay.

rooms.name: SUPERIOR TWIN
rooms.description: The newly and finest twin rooms are designed to accommodate guests seeking comfortable twin beds featuring a serene and inviting atmosphere. Luxuriously appointed with high-quality linens, private safe, and city views.
rooms.fullDescription: Our cozy Superior Twin Rooms are elegantly decorated in soothing white tones, fostering a serene and inviting atmosphere. Each air-conditioned room features a private bathroom, refrigerator, and a flat-screen TV with a variety of international channels. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, a minibar, 24/7 room service, and ample storage space with a spacious wardrobe. The comfortable twin beds and well-organized layout ensure a restful and convenient stay.

rooms.name: PREMIUM DELUXE KING
rooms.description: Our Premium Deluxe King Room is our largest and most luxurious option, offering generous space for families or business travelers. Features a plush king-sized bed, seating area, writing desk, and upscale bathroom amenities.
rooms.fullDescription: Our Premium Deluxe King Room is the largest and most luxurious option, ideal for families or friends seeking an exceptional stay. This exquisite room features a king-size bed, a private bathroom, and a refrigerator. Elegantly decorated, it includes air conditioning, a flat-screen TV with international channels, and all the conveniences of complimentary Wi-Fi, a minibar, 24/7 room service, and a spacious wardrobe. Designed for an unparalleled experience, it promises the utmost in comfort and luxury.

rooms.name: DELUXE KING
rooms.description: Our Deluxe King Rooms offer a luxurious experience, each featuring a comfortable king-sized bed and elegant decor. Each beautifully furnished room offers modern security, high-speed internet, and customized services.
rooms.fullDescription: Our Deluxe King Rooms offer a luxurious experience, with stylish decor and ample space to relax. Each room includes a comfortable king-size bed, a private bathroom, and a refrigerator. Stay comfortable with air conditioning and enjoy entertainment with a flat-screen TV featuring international channels. Additional amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, a minibar, 24/7 room service, and a spacious wardrobe for your belongings.

rooms.name: SUPERIOR KING
rooms.description: Our Superior King Room offers a luxurious and chic king-sized sleeping experience that exceeds every comfort. Our finest room in every aspect, with premium layout, mini-fridge, tea/coffee maker, and city views.
rooms.fullDescription: Our Superior King Rooms offer a cozy and inviting atmosphere to create a relaxing environment. Each room includes a private bathroom, a refrigerator, and a comfortable king-size bed. Additionally, the room is air-conditioned and equipped with a large flat-screen TV offering a selection of international channels. A spacious wardrobe provides ample storage space, ensuring all your belongings are neatly organized.

rooms.name: STANDARD SINGLE
rooms.description: Our Standard Rooms are budget-friendly yet designed to provide a cozy, comfortable and secure stay. Each room offers essential amenities, high-speed Wi-Fi, writing desk, and room service for single travelers.
rooms.fullDescription: Our Standard Rooms are thoughtfully designed to provide comfort and convenience, featuring a private bathroom and a refrigerator for your everyday needs. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, a minibar, 24/7 room service, and ample storage space with an in-room wardrobe. Each room is air-conditioned and equipped with a large flat-screen TV offering a variety of international channels. Additionally, with on-site parking and an in-house restaurant, we ensure that everything you need for a comfortable and enjoyable stay is readily available.
